spinUpS.note: SpinUp only starts the launcher; the catapult's 0.8 s re-cock is in volleyS

volleyS.note: catapult: 0.8 s re-cock, then all 4 at once (spring hood: about 2.0 + 1.35 s)

tipStartS.note: flight about 0.5-0.7 s at 31-44 in, then the rocker starts to move

tipSwingS.note: sim fitted to a 1.0 s TIP on the 3rd POLLEN; 4 POLLEN swing faster. Film one

intakeFullS.note: FLOWER about 1.5-2.0 s (0.5 s a piece); a spill trickles in, full by 2-5 s or not at all

setDownS.note: 0.25 s a piece, a guess: time one

tipLoad.note: FIRST Event Field Setup Guide 12.3: tips on 8 POLLEN

startLoad.note: 3 NECTAR in the raised CELL at the start: the 3rd POLLEN tips it

volleyLoad.note: 4 POLLEN if every shot lands; lower it for misses

driveSpeed.note: 1 = the paths' planned speed; 0.8 = the real robot is 20% slower
